simple.meaning: פֶּשַׂע (pesaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a stride.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

firstOccurrence.englishText: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”
